newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission tells auditors it has changed pig financing.
newsitem.headline: Commission tells auditors it has changed pig financing.

text.p: The European Commission is to tell the European Court of Auditors that they have already reviewed the level of contributions from producers covering compensation for swine fever, an official said on Thursday.

"The Court of Auditors has suggested that the present regime should be reviewed but we have already changed the system so that the Community contribution is only 70 percent in line with other regimes. The 100 percent financing applied only for a very short period," the official said.

In their report due to be published in the next two weeks the Court of Auditors criticises the disease eradication programmes in Belgium and Germany from 1993 to 1995 and suggests that the Commission should examine whether intensive producers should contribute more.
